mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Conditions at Verona City Hall are clear with a temperature of 75 degrees, though the air quality index is 52. Under the new moon, the overnight low will dip to 70 degrees with no rain expected.

The city has announced that road construction begins August 18 along Highway M, which will shift traffic into the westbound lanes for utility work. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review new development projects at their meeting on September 8.

There is a lot to do in Verona! You can join Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow is packed with activities including the downtown farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and several local trivia nights, plus Concerts in the Park this Thursday.
Regarding the weekly report, officers handled a notable incident on August 6, when a driver was arrested for his fourth O W I offence following reports of erratic driving.
You can enjoy the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day at Culver's until they close at 10 PM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
